youtube_title: Ever felt tiny under the stars? | Psalm 8
youtube_description:
Ever looked up at the night sky and felt tiny? In Psalm 8, David does too, and asks, "What is man, that you are mindful of him?"

"Mindful" is the Hebrew zakar (zah-KHAR): to remember. The God who set the stars in place keeps you in mind (Psalm 8:3-4). Hebrews 2:6-9 applies this psalm to Jesus: made lower for a little while, then crowned with glory and honor because he suffered death.

Today's step: tonight, step outside and look up. Let it make you small, then grateful.

Day 8 of the Psalms, one chapter a day. Follow @thebibleexplainedai so you don't miss Psalm 9.

Read it: Psalm 8:1-9 · Hebrews 2:6-9
